title: Basalt bomb

infobox.Crafting Materials: Asksvin hide x1, Asksvin bladder x1, Proustite powder x3

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Basalt bombs can be used to create small platforms when thrown into lava, its main purpose is to reach Flametal ore veins.
The basalt platform created will float in or above the lava for 30 seconds before beginning to sink into the lava at a slow rate.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
• Asksvin hide x1
• Asksvin bladder x1
• Proustite powder x3

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text:
• Crafted with the workbench
• Asksvin hides and Asksvin bladders are dropped from Asksvin in the Ashlands.
• Proustite powder is dropped from Lava Blobs and Unstable lava rocks in the Ashlands.

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text: • Once the deposit (usually a Lavaiathan) is reached, the Flametal ore can then be mined until it is all collected or the deposit sinks down into the lava, similar to a leviathan in the Ocean.

full_text:
Basalt bomb

Internal ID: BombLava | Type: Bomb | Source: Workbench | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Asksvin hide x1, Asksvin bladder x1, Proustite powder x3

Introduction. Basalt bombs can be used to create small platforms when thrown into lava, its main purpose is to reach Flametal ore veins.
The basalt platform created will float in or above the lava for 30 seconds before beginning to sink into the lava at a slow rate.

Recipe. • Asksvin hide x1
• Asksvin bladder x1
• Proustite powder x3

Availability. • Crafted with the workbench
• Asksvin hides and Asksvin bladders are dropped from Asksvin in the Ashlands.
• Proustite powder is dropped from Lava Blobs and Unstable lava rocks in the Ashlands.

Tips. • Once the deposit (usually a Lavaiathan) is reached, the Flametal ore can then be mined until it is all collected or the deposit sinks down into the lava, similar to a leviathan in the Ocean.
